author: documentation author
scope: Independent full-text review of the English README and formalization guide against the frozen manuscript, semantic mapping, final verification result, source-closure record, and actual Lean declaration inventory. This is a documentation correspondence review, not a new kernel run.
checks: Read both documents in full. Paper title and author names match the manuscript; dimensions, ordinary progressive finite-energy controls, original usually augmented Brownian filtration, and all-positive-horizon classification retain their mathematical scope.

All 19 distinct theorem entry points are present in the audited declaration inventory; every linked Lean source exists. Readable module families are presented as reading guidance, not as an alternative dependency graph.
Counts match the actual successful historical gate: 384 modules, 2559 explicit names, 1942 theorems plus 73 lemmas = 2015, 80 complete inventory obligations and 18 named statements.

The source closure records exactly eight sorry sites in the four stated upstream modules (2,1,1,4); every audited named declaration has an allowed axiom closure. The documents disclose rather than hide this distinction.
All five manuscript revisions are disclosed, including positive system dimensions and removal of superseded pathwise/QV proof passages. No coverage is claimed for removed arguments.
AI semantic review, kernel reliance, exact-arithmetic versus floating-point boundaries, noncomputable QE, and absence of a blanket relicensing claim are stated accurately.

Lean, Mathlib and MathFin pins match the actual toolchain and Lake configuration. Both documents describe the planned public verifier command; execution and release-layout testing are a separate release-gate obligation, not claimed completed by this review.

Re-read the exact final diff: Python 3.11 or later is now explicit; README adds claims.en.json, report.html, and verification/verification.json navigation. The current public verifier uses formalization/audit/claims.en.json and formalization/verification/verification.json. The parent release assembly must generate the referenced HTML/PDF and run the release gate; no new mathematical or audit-status assertion was introduced by this diff.
limits: The public verify_release.py implementation and clean public-layout execution require their own independent checks; this review does not assert that those checks have already run.
This review does not provide a legal determination of redistribution rights.
final_revision_scope: Only interpreter-version wording and public-result/index navigation changed from the previously reviewed documentation. All mathematical and trust-boundary prose is byte-identical.
